this drives rapid PR gains but gives no gradient on structural quality.\\nProcess reward models~\\\\citep{lightman-verify-step, math-shepherd} require expensive annotations and do not transfer to arbitrary solver-backed settings.\\nA separate line documents that LLMs already game logical formalization at inference time~\\\\citep{kim-game-formalization, bondarenko-spec-gaming}; \paragraph{What ISR measures---and what it does not.}
ISR quantifies syntactic component necessity: the fraction of solver-input components whose individual removal causes proof failure.

\subsection{Early-Training Hacking Analysis (100-Step Checkpoint)}
